g.text: Launcher: 4 % of lift-off mass reaches LEO. Earth-sourced: expendable LOX/LH₂ stages, Isp 450 s, dry mass 10 % of propellant; Δv LEO→L1 3.8, →LLO 4.0, →lunar surface 5.9 km/s.
Moon-sourced: reusable LOX/LH₂ tanker (10 t dry, 30 t loaded) keeps propellant to return; Δv surface→LLO 1.9, →L1 2.5, →LEO 2.8 km/s (aerobraking). Plant and tanker mass in (b) landed from Earth.
